title: A pesti srácok és a fegyveres ellenállás (The Boys of Pest & Corvin Passage)
grammar: Directives of Freedom, Asymmetric Warfare & Sovereign Historical Discourse

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say who the pesti srácok were and how they fought the Soviet tanks.
I can say what the Corvin köz was.
I can say what a Molotov-koktél and a barikád were.
I can use six words about the armed resistance, such as szabadságharcos and fegyveres ellenállás.
